style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley 2 X Pre-lit Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: One garland dresses a mantel. Two give you 3.6m in total, for dressing a mantel and a staircase, or a longer banister. Because both are identical, the light spacing and foliage tone stay consistent from one to the next. Each garland has 50 warm white LEDs already fitted and 133 branch tips for a full, lifelike look. Both are battery powered, so you are not tied to a socket. Fan the branches out by hand and they re ready to style. Best kept indoors or in a protected area. Batteries aren t included – you ll need three AA for each garland. Branches need fanning out by hand to look their best. Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Dimensions(mm): Height: 270 Width: 1800 Depth: 540.
